positive_evidence: Team composition, positioning, equipment, mutations and route planning create concrete tactical problems with a short evaluate-build-test loop, closely matching the user's confirmed enjoyment of understandable local tactical challenges.
Run-based combinations and mutations provide opportunities to experiment with different approaches instead of relying on a single fixed build.

taste_factors.gameplay_and_controls: mixed_positive: meaningful decisions happen before automatic battles; this favors tactical problem-solving but offers less direct mechanical control.
taste_factors.development_and_variety: mixed: builds and mutations create experimentation, while repeated events and meta builds can reduce variety over time.
taste_factors.mastery_and_depth: positive: success depends on learning composition, positioning and resource decisions, a good match for mastery through understandable systems.
taste_factors.difficulty: mixed: punishing snowball losses and bad rolls can make failure feel less attributable to skill, weakening the otherwise positive challenge signal.
taste_factors.pacing_and_repetition: risk: limited long-term progression and repeated events may make later runs feel too similar.
taste_factors.atmosphere_and_identity: moderate_positive: the dystopian army-battler premise is distinctive, though dossier evidence focuses more on systems than presentation.
taste_factors.story_and_characters: neutral: no material narrative hook is established.
taste_factors.controls_friction: minor_uncertain_risk: one Russian Steam Deck report describes unclear panel/unit navigation; this is anecdotal and platform-specific.
